milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to the stone bricks hut and look toward the brown glazed terracotta block inside it. The target is at spawn-relative (7, 1, 8). max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to have entered or be at the entrance of the small hut. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actively looking toward the block, confirming visual identification.
